title: Enum token conventions
description: Grammar every enum value in this repository must satisfy: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE tokens of at most 64 characters, starting with a letter. Enums are closed sets of string tokens declared with a sibling type of string. Evolution rules: adding a token is a MINOR schema change (existing instances stay valid); removing or renaming a token is a MAJOR change. Validators reject undeclared tokens outright; there is no implicit pass-through of unknown enum values.
